families.name: Bass
families.note: The low end. Mono almost always; the filter envelope and the decay shape are the whole character.

items.name: Sub Bass
items.essentials: Sine (or triangle), no filter, instant attack, held sustain, short release. One octave down.
items.teaches: Pure fundamental; why sub needs no harmonics
concepts: Sine: no response to filtering; FM/additive building block

items.name: 808 Bass
items.essentials: Sine, pitch envelope drops ~1 octave in 20–60 ms, long amp decay (1–3 s), light saturation for upper harmonics.
items.teaches: Pitch envelope as punch; decay as length

items.name: House Bass
items.essentials: Square (or pulse) + sub, resonant LPF, filter env: instant attack, short decay, zero sustain. Amp: fast attack, medium decay.
items.teaches: Percussive filter envelope; the pluck is in the filter not the amp
concepts: Envelope → filter cutoff (bite; auto-wah with long attack)

items.name: Acid Bass
items.essentials: Saw or square, high-resonance LPF (~18 dB/oct), filter env decay 100–300 ms, env amount high, accent = more env, slide = glide on tied notes.
items.teaches: Resonance + envelope depth; accent and slide as performance

items.name: Moog Bass
items.essentials: Saw + square an octave apart, 24 dB ladder LPF, cutoff lowish, filter env short decay, slight drive.
items.teaches: Two-osc stacking; ladder filter slope; drive
concepts: Combining waveforms: square + saw octave up (zipper)
Filter models and their distortion (sine test)

items.name: Reese Bass
items.essentials: Two saws detuned 10–30 cents, little or no filter movement, the beat frequency is the sound. Often chorus or phaser later.

items.name: Wobble Bass
items.essentials: Saw or square, LPF with LFO on cutoff synced to tempo (1/4–1/16), high resonance, distortion after.
items.teaches: LFO as rhythmic modulation; tempo sync

items.name: Neuro Bass
items.essentials: FM or wavetable with heavy saturation, resampled and re-filtered; movement from several slow LFOs on different targets.
items.teaches: Layered modulation; resampling as a technique

items.name: FM Bass
items.essentials: Two operators 1:1, modulator index with a short envelope, carrier sine, no filter.
items.teaches: FM index envelope as timbral pluck

items.name: Pluck Bass
items.essentials: Saw, LPF, filter env very short decay, amp env short too; velocity → filter.

items.name: Synthwave Bass
items.essentials: Square, LPF closed-ish, amp env short decay no sustain, sequenced 16ths, slight chorus.

items.name: PWM Bass
items.essentials: Pulse with LFO on width (slow), LPF, held notes.

items.name: Sync Bass
items.essentials: Osc2 hard-synced to osc1, env sweeps osc2 pitch, LPF open.

items.name: Growl Bass
items.essentials: Saw into a formant or band-pass with LFO/env on vowel position, drive.

items.name: Donk
items.essentials: Sine or triangle with a pitch env (fast drop), very short decay, hard; plus a filter ping.

items.name: Hoover Bass
items.essentials: Detuned saws with pitch sweep down into the note, PWM-ish, chorus. The hoover in the bass register.

items.name: Organ Bass
items.essentials: Sine + 1 octave up + 1 fifth up (3 drawbars), no filter, instant envelopes.

items.name: Saturated Bass
items.essentials: Saw, LPF, mild filter env, then distortion/overdrive to fill the mid.
concepts: Drive: by velocity, by envelope; serial filter after

items.name: Layered Sub + Tone
items.essentials: Layer A: sub sine. Layer B: saw/square LPF with the character, high-passed at ~80 Hz.
items.teaches: Layering; splitting a sound by frequency band

items.name: Portamento Bass
items.essentials: Saw, LPF, glide 50–150 ms on legato notes only.
concepts: Glide / portamento time; legato mode as default

items.name: Triangle Chip Bass
items.essentials: Triangle wave, no filter, instant envelopes.

items.name: Square-Sub Techno Bass
items.essentials: Square, LPF low cutoff, short amp decay, sidechained; the sound is the hole the kick leaves.

families.name: Leads
families.note: A single voice meant to be heard as a line. Mono with glide, or poly for stacks.

items.name: Saw Lead
items.essentials: Saw, LPF mostly open, modest filter env, vibrato by mod wheel, glide short.

items.name: Square Lead
items.essentials: Square, no or light LPF, vibrato LFO delayed by ~300 ms.

items.name: PWM Lead
items.essentials: Pulse with slow LFO on width, LPF, chorus-like thickness from one osc.

items.name: Sync Lead
items.essentials: Hard sync, osc2 pitch swept by env or wheel; aggressive, formant-like.
items.teaches: Hard sync as a timbral control

items.name: Supersaw Lead
items.essentials: 7 saws detuned ±20–40 cents, LPF, mild filter env, big reverb.

items.name: Hoover
items.essentials: Detuned saws + PWM, pitch envelope sweeps down into the note, chorus.

items.name: Trance Pluck
items.essentials: Saw, LPF, filter env fast decay, delay + reverb; sequenced.

items.name: FM Bright Lead
items.essentials: Carrier sine, modulator 2:1 or 3:1, high index with slow decay.

items.name: Sine Lead
items.essentials: Sine with vibrato and glide; theremin-like.
items.teaches: Expression with no timbre: pitch and amp only
concepts: Sine: no response to filtering; FM/additive building block

items.name: Flute Lead
items.essentials: Sine or triangle + breath noise on attack, slow vibrato, soft attack ~30 ms.

items.name: Brass Lead
items.essentials: Saw, LPF, filter env with attack ~50 ms (the 'blat'), slight detune.
concepts: Envelope → filter cutoff (bite; auto-wah with long attack)

items.name: Distorted Lead
items.essentials: Saw or square, LPF, drive/distortion, feedback delay.
concepts: Distortion: nonlinear, harmonic, compresses dynamics, tames resonance

items.name: Acid Lead
items.essentials: The acid bass played high: saw, high res, env mod, slide.

items.name: Screech Lead
items.essentials: Square or saw, high resonance near self-oscillation, filter env, pitch bend.
items.teaches: Filter at the edge of self-oscillation

items.name: Whistle
items.essentials: Sine, fast vibrato, soft attack, HPF removes body.

items.name: Ring-Mod Lead
items.essentials: Two oscs through a ring modulator, inharmonic; env on osc2 pitch.

items.name: Vocal / Formant Lead
items.essentials: Saw into 2–3 band-passes at vowel formants; wheel moves the vowel.
concepts: Narrow pulse → nasal / vocal, with formant filter

items.name: Dub Siren
items.essentials: Square or saw, LFO on pitch (fast-ish), spring reverb and delay.

items.name: Chip Arp Lead
items.essentials: Pulse 25%, arpeggiator at 1/32 across a chord, no filter.

items.name: Soft Lead
items.essentials: Triangle + sine, LPF, slow attack, chorus.
items.teaches: Gentle timbres; triangle as a soft saw

items.name: Wavetable Scan Lead
items.essentials: Wavetable osc, env or LFO scans table position, LPF.
items.teaches: Wavetable position as a timbre axis

items.name: Phase-Distortion Lead
items.essentials: PD osc (CZ-style), env on distortion amount.
items.teaches: Phase distortion as a filter substitute

families.name: Pads
families.note: Slow attack, long release, movement. Poly; the modulation is the sound.

items.name: Supersaw Pad
items.essentials: Detuned saw stack, LPF half open, attack ~500 ms, release ~1.5 s, reverb.

items.name: Warm Analog Pad
items.essentials: Two saws slightly detuned, LPF ~1 kHz, slow filter env, chorus.

items.name: String Machine
items.essentials: Saw, no filter envelope, ensemble/chorus heavy, medium attack.
concepts: Chorus: multiple delays, own LFOs, no feedback

items.name: Evolving Pad
items.essentials: Wavetable with slow LFO on position, second LFO on filter, long attack.

items.name: Choir Pad
items.essentials: Saw/pulse into formant 'ah', chorus, slow attack.

items.name: Glass / Bell Pad
items.essentials: FM 1:3.5 or additive with soft attack, long release, reverb.

items.name: Dark Pad
items.essentials: Square, LPF low, no filter env, slow attack.

items.name: PWM Pad
items.essentials: Pulse with LFO on width, chorus, slow envelopes.

items.name: Sweep Pad
items.essentials: Saw, LPF with very slow filter env (attack 3–8 s), resonance moderate.
items.teaches: Filter envelope as the arc of a note

items.name: Drone
items.essentials: Several detuned oscs, no envelope (gate held), slow random modulation.

items.name: Granular Pad
items.essentials: Granular engine on a sample, long grains, random position.

items.name: Shimmer Pad
items.essentials: Simple pad into pitch-shifted (+12) feedback reverb.

items.name: Brass Pad
items.essentials: Saws, LPF, filter env attack ~100 ms, release medium.

items.name: Noise Wash
items.essentials: White/pink noise, band-pass with LFO on center, slow envelopes.
items.teaches: Noise as a pad; band-pass sweep

items.name: Vocal Pad
items.essentials: Formant-filtered saw, chorus, LFO on vowel.

items.name: Lo-Fi Tape Pad
items.essentials: Warm pad + wow/flutter LFO on pitch (slow, random), bit of noise, LPF.

items.name: Stacked Fifth Pad
items.essentials: Osc2 +7 semitones, detune, LPF.

items.name: Orchestral Strings
items.essentials: Saws, HPF a little, LPF, attack ~200 ms, vibrato LFO, ensemble.

families.name: Keys and Mallets
families.note: Played like a keyboard: fast attack, decay that tells the material.

items.name: FM Electric Piano
items.essentials: Carrier sine, modulator 1:1 (or 14:1 tine), index envelope fast decay, velocity → index, tremolo.

items.name: Bell
items.essentials: FM ratio 1:3.5 (inharmonic), long decay, no sustain.

items.name: Pluck
items.essentials: Saw, LPF, filter env decay ~150 ms no sustain, amp decay ~400 ms.
concepts: Envelope → filter cutoff (bite; auto-wah with long attack)

items.name: Chord Stab
items.essentials: Saw + square, LPF, short amp decay, played as a chord; unison 2.

items.name: Organ
items.essentials: Sine drawbars 16' 8' 4' (+ 2 2/3'), instant envelopes, no filter, rotary/vibrato.
concepts: Additive: sines in a harmonic series

items.name: Clavinet
items.essentials: Narrow pulse, HPF, fast decay, velocity → filter, auto-wah.

items.name: Harpsichord
items.essentials: Saw + narrow pulse, short decay, bright, slight release click.

items.name: Marimba
items.essentials: Sine + a 4th-harmonic partial, very fast decay, pitch env tiny.
concepts: Pluck / strike: release = decay; gong vs marimba

items.name: Vibraphone
items.essentials: Sine + soft partial, medium decay, tremolo LFO on amp.

items.name: Kalimba
items.essentials: Sine with short inharmonic partial, fast decay, click on attack.

items.name: Music Box
items.essentials: Additive bright partials, very fast decay, high register.

items.name: Celesta
items.essentials: Sine + triangle, medium decay, bright attack.

items.name: Steel Drum
items.essentials: FM with pitch env rise, inharmonic overtone, medium decay.

items.name: Toy Piano
items.essentials: Square-ish + bell partial, fast decay, detuned.

items.name: Wurlitzer
items.essentials: FM EP with saturation, shorter decay, more 'bark' at velocity.

items.name: Synth Piano
items.essentials: Saw + pulse, LPF, filter env velocity-scaled, decay ~2 s.

items.name: Mellotron Strings
items.essentials: Sampled-string feel: saw, LPF, no sustain beyond 8 s, slow attack, flutter.

families.name: Plucked Strings
families.note: Decay-only envelopes, often physical-model or very short filter envelopes.

items.name: Karplus-Strong String
items.essentials: Noise burst into a short feedback delay; damping sets decay.

items.name: Guitar Pluck
items.essentials: Saw + pulse, LPF, filter env decay ~200 ms, amp decay ~1.5 s.

items.name: Harp
items.essentials: Triangle + sine, fast decay with long release tail, bright attack.

items.name: Koto
items.essentials: Pulse, HPF, filter env, bend on attack.

items.name: Pizzicato
items.essentials: Saw, LPF low, very short decay.

items.name: Sitar
items.essentials: Saw + sympathetic resonator (comb), bright decay, drone.

items.name: Banjo
items.essentials: Narrow pulse, HPF, click, fast decay.

families.name: Brass and Winds
families.note: The filter envelope's attack is the instrument.

items.name: Synth Brass
items.essentials: Saws detuned, LPF, filter env attack 50–100 ms then decay, vibrato delayed.

items.name: Trumpet
items.essentials: Saw, LPF, filter env attack, slight pitch env up at the start, vibrato.

items.name: Horn Section
items.essentials: Synth brass with wider detune and octave doubling.

items.name: Saxophone
items.essentials: Saw + noise, LPF, growl LFO (fast, tiny) on pitch and amp.

items.name: Flute
items.essentials: Sine/triangle + breath noise, soft attack, vibrato.
concepts: Noise at the attack; noise oscillator with its own envelope

items.name: Clarinet
items.essentials: Square (odd harmonics), LPF, soft attack.

items.name: Oboe
items.essentials: Narrow pulse, LPF, band-pass peak ~1.5 kHz, vibrato.

items.name: Bagpipe
items.essentials: Drone saws + chanter pulse, no envelopes, slight detune.

items.name: Harmonica
items.essentials: Pulse + saw, band-pass, tremolo via wheel.

items.name: Pan Flute
items.essentials: Sine + lots of breath noise, chiff attack.

families.name: Drums and Percussion
families.note: Mostly one-shots: noise, sine, pitch envelopes. Teaches transient design.

items.name: 808 Kick
items.essentials: Sine, pitch env drops fast, amp decay long, slight saturation.

items.name: 909 Kick
items.essentials: Sine with faster pitch env + click (noise burst, 5 ms), shorter decay, drive.

items.name: Snare
items.essentials: Noise (HPF/BPF) + tuned sine ~180 Hz, both short decay, noise longer.
concepts: Noise at the attack; noise oscillator with its own envelope

items.name: Clap
items.essentials: Noise bursts ×3–4 spaced ~10 ms, then a longer noise tail, BPF.

items.name: Closed Hi-Hat
items.essentials: Noise or 6 detuned squares (metallic), HPF high, decay ~50 ms.

items.name: Open Hi-Hat
items.essentials: Same as closed, decay ~400 ms, choke group.

items.name: Tom
items.essentials: Sine with pitch env, decay ~300 ms, slight noise.

items.name: Rimshot
items.essentials: Short pulse click + BPF noise, 30 ms.

items.name: Cowbell
items.essentials: Two squares at ~540 and ~800 Hz, BPF, fast decay.

items.name: Clave
items.essentials: Sine ~2.5 kHz, 20 ms decay.

items.name: Conga
items.essentials: Sine with small pitch env, decay 150 ms, slight filter.

items.name: Shaker
items.essentials: Noise, BPF high, envelope with slight attack.

items.name: Crash
items.essentials: Noise + metallic squares, long decay, HPF.

items.name: Ride
items.essentials: Metallic squares + noise, BPF, medium decay, ping.

items.name: Zap / Laser
items.essentials: Pitch env drops 3 octaves fast on a saw/square.

items.name: FM Percussion
items.essentials: FM 1:1.4 inharmonic, very short decay.

items.name: Sub Boom
items.essentials: Sine, slow pitch env down, 2 s decay.

items.name: Woodblock
items.essentials: Sine ~800 Hz + click, 40 ms.

items.name: Timbale
items.essentials: Pitch env sine + noise, metallic ring.

items.name: Kick Layered (click/body/sub)
items.essentials: Three layers: click noise, pitch-env body, sub sine.

families.name: Sound Effects
families.note: Not notes: sweeps, bursts, textures. Mostly noise and modulation.

items.name: Riser
items.essentials: Noise + saw, LPF sweeping up over 2–8 bars, pitch up, reverb.

items.name: Downlifter
items.essentials: The riser reversed: pitch and filter fall.

items.name: Impact
items.essentials: Sub boom + noise burst + reverb tail.

items.name: Sweep (Filter Whoosh)
items.essentials: Noise, BPF with env on center frequency.

items.name: White Noise Burst
items.essentials: Noise, instant attack, short decay.

items.name: Siren
items.essentials: Square, slow triangle LFO on pitch.

items.name: Wind
items.essentials: Pink noise, slow random LFO on BPF center and amp.

items.name: Rain
items.essentials: Noise, HPF, fast random amp modulation.

items.name: Thunder
items.essentials: Brown noise, LPF, slow random amp, long decay.

items.name: Explosion
items.essentials: Noise + sub, LPF closing over 1 s, distortion.

items.name: UI Blip
items.essentials: Sine or square, 50 ms, small pitch env up.

items.name: Alarm
items.essentials: Square, square LFO on pitch (two notes), fast.

items.name: Glitch / Stutter
items.essentials: Any tone, retrigger via fast square LFO on amp, sample & hold on pitch.

items.name: Metallic Hit
items.essentials: Ring mod or FM inharmonic, fast decay, reverb.

items.name: Vinyl Crackle
items.essentials: Noise, HPF, very short random bursts.

items.name: Ocean Waves
items.essentials: Pink noise, very slow LFO on amp and LPF.

families.name: Rhythmic and Sequenced
families.note: Where the modulation is in time with the music.

items.name: Arpeggio
items.essentials: Pluck + arpeggiator 1/16 up/down, delay dotted 8th.

items.name: Gated Pad
items.essentials: Pad with square LFO (1/8 or 1/16) on amp.

items.name: Sidechained Pad
items.essentials: Pad ducked by the kick (compressor or LFO shaped like a kick).

items.name: Pulsing Bass
items.essentials: Bass with LFO on filter at 1/8, sidechained.

items.name: Acid Sequence
items.essentials: Acid bass + 16-step sequence with accents and slides.

items.name: Rhythmic Stab
items.essentials: Chord stab with delay in a syncopated pattern.

items.name: Sample-and-Hold Melody
items.essentials: Pulse, S&H LFO on pitch quantized to a scale.

items.name: Tremolo Chord
items.essentials: Pad with fast triangle LFO on amp.

items.name: Auto-Pan Pad
items.essentials: Pad with LFO on pan, slow.

items.name: Euclidean Pluck
items.essentials: Pluck triggered by a Euclidean rhythm.

families.name: Technique Demonstrations
families.note: Not a genre sound: a single technique isolated so you can hear it.

items.name: Vibrato (LFO → Pitch)
items.essentials: Sine, sine LFO 5–6 Hz on pitch, depth ±20 cents, delayed onset.
concepts: Vibrato: ~5 Hz, under a semitone; dedicated vibrato LFO

items.name: Tremolo (LFO → Amp)
items.essentials: Sine, LFO 4–8 Hz on amp.

items.name: Auto-Wah (LFO → Filter)
items.essentials: Saw, BPF or LPF with LFO on cutoff.

items.name: ADSR Walkthrough
items.essentials: Saw, LPF open; one envelope, each stage exaggerated in turn.
items.teaches: What A, D, S and R each do
concepts: ADSR: three times and a level

items.name: Filter Types
items.essentials: Saw, same cutoff on LP / HP / BP / notch.

items.name: Filter Slope
items.essentials: Saw, LPF 12 vs 24 dB/oct at the same cutoff.

items.name: Resonance Sweep
items.essentials: Saw, LPF cutoff swept slowly at low, medium, self-oscillating Q.

items.name: Keytracking
items.essentials: Saw, LPF; play low to high with keytrack off then on.

items.name: Velocity → Filter
items.essentials: Saw, LPF, velocity drives filter env amount.

items.name: Unison and Detune
items.essentials: One saw, then 2, 4, 8 voices with increasing detune.

items.name: Sub Oscillator
items.essentials: Square + sub square one octave down, mix swept.

items.name: Pulse Width Sweep
items.essentials: Pulse, width swept 50% → 5% by hand, then by LFO.

items.name: Hard Sync Sweep
items.essentials: Osc2 synced, osc2 pitch swept up two octaves.

items.name: Ring Modulation
items.essentials: Two sines, ring mod output; vary ratio.

items.name: Amplitude Modulation
items.essentials: Carrier sine, AM by sine at audio rate.

items.name: FM Two-Operator
items.essentials: Carrier + modulator, ratio 1:1, 2:1, 1:3.5; index swept.
concepts: Sine: no response to filtering; FM/additive building block

items.name: Feedback FM
items.essentials: Single operator with self-feedback swept.

items.name: Wavetable Position Sweep
items.essentials: Wavetable osc, position swept by hand then LFO.

items.name: Additive Drawbars
items.essentials: 8 sines at harmonics 1–8, levels as drawbars.
concepts: Additive: sines in a harmonic series

items.name: Waveshaping
items.essentials: Sine into a tanh/fold shaper, drive swept.
concepts: Distortion: nonlinear, harmonic, compresses dynamics, tames resonance

items.name: Phase Distortion
items.essentials: PD osc, distortion amount swept.

items.name: Formant Vowels
items.essentials: Saw into 3 BPFs; move a-e-i-o-u.
concepts: Parallel: twin peaks, keytracking amount, vocal formants

items.name: Comb Filter
items.essentials: Saw into a short delay with feedback, delay time swept.
concepts: Comb filter: a short delay is a filter
Comb filter: delay time and frequency are reciprocals

items.name: Noise Colors
items.essentials: White, pink, brown noise compared.
concepts: Waveforms: saw, square, triangle, sine, noise

items.name: Sample and Hold
items.essentials: Saw, S&H LFO on filter at 1/8.

items.name: Portamento
items.essentials: Saw, glide time 0 / 50 / 300 ms, legato vs always.
concepts: Glide / portamento time; legato mode as default

items.name: Mono vs Poly vs Legato
items.essentials: Same patch in each voice mode, retrigger on/off.

items.name: Envelope Curves
items.essentials: Same ADSR with linear vs exponential stages.

items.name: Oscillator Drift
items.essentials: Saw with tiny random pitch per voice, then none.

items.name: Stereo Width
items.essentials: Unison with pan spread 0 → full.
concepts: Stereo width by L/R delay difference; detune and filter per side

items.name: Oscillator Mix (Saw/Square/Tri/Sine)
items.essentials: Four waveforms, same note, same envelope.
concepts: Waveforms: saw, square, triangle, sine, noise

items.name: Karplus-Strong Damping
items.essentials: KS string, damping swept.

items.name: Modulation Matrix
items.essentials: One LFO routed to pitch, then filter, then amp, then PWM.

families.name: Filter Routings
families.note: Two filters, one lesson each. From Loudon's notes: serial and parallel schemes, each a template.

items.name: Serial: Notch then Low-Pass
items.essentials: Saw. Filter 1 notch (low res) in the mids; filter 2 LP 12 dB sets the highs. Serial.
items.teaches: Serial routing; notch to clear mids while keeping presence

items.name: Serial: Source and Resonator
items.essentials: Filter 1 LP with full keytracking (the timbre); filter 2 LP/BP with no keytracking (the body). Serial.
items.teaches: Keytracked vs fixed filter; formant regions
concepts: Serial: source and resonator (keytracked vs fixed)

items.name: Serial: Flexible Band-Pass
items.essentials: Filter 1 HP low cutoff, filter 2 LP high cutoff; raise resonance for 'horns' at both edges. Serial.
items.teaches: Two filters as one adjustable band-pass
concepts: Serial: flexible band-pass (HP + LP) with horns

items.name: Serial: Extreme 48 dB
items.essentials: Both filters LP 24 dB, identical settings (slave if available); then give them slightly different modulation.

items.name: Serial: Dual Notch Pad
items.essentials: Two notch filters, two slow unsynced LFOs with different rates, a little noise, max unison.
items.teaches: Unsynced LFOs; noise builds with polyphony
concepts: Noise for softness and high end
Serial: dual notch pad with two unsynced LFOs

items.name: Serial: Bring Out the Noise
items.essentials: LP 24 dB set low, then BP high cutoff with very high resonance to lift a couple of partials back up.
items.teaches: Resonance recovers what was cut; exposes filter models
concepts: Serial: bring out the noise (LP then high-Q BP)

items.name: Serial: Notch vs Band-Pass Tug
items.essentials: Notch (low res) and BP (high res) at the same cutoff; modulate them differently.
concepts: Resonance as width (Q) on band-pass and notch
Serial: notch vs band-pass tug of war

items.name: Parallel: Dual Low-Pass
items.essentials: Two LP 24 dB in parallel near 300 Hz; slowly modulate one. The second only ever adds.

items.name: Parallel: Flexible Notch with Horns
items.essentials: HP and LP in parallel, HP cutoff above LP cutoff for a mid notch; send 90% to LP, 10% to HP; inverted envelope on the HP (sustain 0); a little noise to the HP.
items.teaches: Parallel notch; inverted envelope; mix balance
concepts: Parallel: flexible notch with horns, inverted HP envelope, mix balance

items.name: Parallel: Twin Peaks
items.essentials: Two BP in parallel: one at the fundamental with full keytracking, one higher with partial keytracking and more resonance.
items.teaches: Keytracking amount as per-note character; vocal formants
concepts: Parallel: twin peaks, keytracking amount, vocal formants

items.name: Parallel: Low-Pass and Band-Pass Accent
items.essentials: LP keytracked for timbre; BP with no keytracking placed in the mix, resonance driven by a fast decay envelope scaled by velocity; a hint of overdrive after.
items.teaches: Envelope → resonance; velocity → envelope amount; stationary accent band
concepts: Parallel: low-pass + band-pass accent (env → resonance, velocity)

items.name: Filter Thunk
items.essentials: Resonant LP under 100 Hz in parallel with the main voice; a little keytracking, a lot of velocity modulation; subtle.

items.name: SVF Morph in Motion
items.essentials: State-variable filter, morph LP→BP→HP modulated by a slow LFO at small depth.
concepts: SVF morph, modulated in small amounts

items.name: Filter Model Test
items.essentials: Sine through each filter model at high resonance; watch the analyzer for added harmonics.
concepts: Filter models and their distortion (sine test)

items.name: Drive by Velocity
items.essentials: Saw, LP with drive; velocity → drive, or an envelope → drive for bite on the attack; second filter after to tame it.
concepts: Drive: by velocity, by envelope; serial filter after
Distortion: nonlinear, harmonic, compresses dynamics, tames resonance

items.name: Low-Res Notch on Bass
items.essentials: Big bass with a low-resonance notch in the mids; keeps the brightness and the sub, leaves room for everything else.
concepts: Resonance as width (Q) on band-pass and notch

items.name: Self-Oscillating Filter as Oscillator
items.essentials: Filter resonance past self-oscillation, keytracked 100%, oscillator muted; ping with a short envelope.
items.teaches: Filter as a sine source; pinging

families.name: Envelope Shapes
families.note: Loudon's envelope library: one amp envelope per shape, on a plain saw through an open filter.

items.name: Switch (Organ)
items.essentials: A 0, S 100%, R 0; decay does nothing.

items.name: Percussive Organ
items.essentials: A 0, D very short, S 80%, R 0.
items.teaches: A little bite on a sustaining envelope

items.name: Standard Sustaining
items.essentials: A 0–10%, D 0–10%, S 50–90%, R 0–10%. Blown or bowed: burst then steady.
concepts: Standard sustaining envelope; strings and horns variants

items.name: Strings (Long Sustaining)
items.essentials: The sustaining shape with longer A, D and R.
concepts: Standard sustaining envelope; strings and horns variants

items.name: Horns (Low Sustain)
items.essentials: The sustaining shape with a lower sustain: the first burst of air is strong.
items.teaches: Sustain level as the player's breath
concepts: Standard sustaining envelope; strings and horns variants

items.name: Pluck / Strike (Release = Decay)
items.essentials: A 0, D 10–80%, S 0, R same as D. Plays out whether or not you hold.
concepts: Pluck / strike: release = decay; gong vs marimba

items.name: Gong (Long Decay)
items.essentials: Strike shape with a very long decay and release.
concepts: Pluck / strike: release = decay; gong vs marimba

items.name: Piano (Damper)
items.essentials: A 0, D 10–80%, S 0, R 0. Release stops the note like a damper.

items.name: Reverse (Swell and Stop)
items.essentials: A 80–100%, D 0–20%, S 0, R 0. Swells in, then stops.

items.name: The Funny Envelope
items.essentials: A 0, D 10–30%, S 0, R 50–100%. Long notes end short; short notes end long.
concepts: The funny envelope: long notes short, short notes long

items.name: One-Shot / Trigger Mode
items.essentials: Any percussive shape in trigger mode: ignores note-off and plays out.

items.name: Keytracked Decay
items.essentials: Strike shape; keytracking → decay and release, negative, so high notes are shorter.

items.name: Velocity → Attack (Negative)
items.essentials: Sustaining shape; higher velocity shortens the attack.

items.name: Envelope → Pitch (Attack Blip)
items.essentials: Pitch envelope starts high and settles fast into the note.

items.name: Inverted Filter Envelope
items.essentials: Filter envelope negative: the cutoff dips on the attack and recovers over the decay.
concepts: Parallel: flexible notch with horns, inverted HP envelope, mix balance

families.name: Voices, Tuning and Retrigger
families.note: The oscillator section's less obvious controls, each isolated.

items.name: Harmonic-Series Oscillator Stack
items.essentials: Oscillators tuned to the harmonic table: root; +1 oct; +1 oct 7 semi; +2 oct; +2 oct 4 semi −13 c; +2 oct 7 semi; +2 oct 10 semi −30 c; +3 oct. Tune the cents by ear.
items.teaches: Octave / semitone / fine as the harmonic series

items.name: Seven-Cent Detune
items.essentials: Two saws detuned ≤7 cents.

items.name: Octave Stack (Weight and Shimmer)
items.essentials: Two oscs an octave apart, mix swept.

items.name: Interval Stack (Fifth)
items.essentials: Osc2 +7 semitones; then +4, +10.

items.name: Square + Saw Octave Up (Zipper)
items.essentials: Square at the root, saw an octave up: odd and even partials interlock. Filter each separately if the synth allows.
concepts: Combining waveforms: square + saw octave up (zipper)

items.name: Free-Running vs Retriggered Oscillator
items.essentials: Instant amp envelope; compare oscillator free vs retrigger at 0° vs retrigger at 90° (the click).
items.teaches: Phase and retrigger; the attack click
concepts: Phase, free-running vs retrigger, the click

items.name: Noise Oscillator with Its Own Envelope
items.essentials: Main osc with a sustaining envelope; noise osc with a very short envelope on the attack only.
concepts: Noise at the attack; noise oscillator with its own envelope

items.name: Noise for Softness
items.essentials: Pad with a little pink noise mixed in, LP.
items.teaches: Noise as texture and high end
concepts: Noise for softness and high end

items.name: Narrow Pulse into Formant
items.essentials: Pulse ~10% into a formant filter; wheel moves vowel.
items.teaches: Narrow pulse as the nasal starting point
concepts: Narrow pulse → nasal / vocal, with formant filter

items.name: Voice Priority: Last / Top / Bottom
items.essentials: Mono bass with priority Bottom layered under a poly pad; then Top for the melody.
concepts: Voice priority: last / top / bottom; voice stealing

items.name: Unison × Voices Budget
items.essentials: Unison 2 on a 4-voice limit: hear voice stealing at the third note.
concepts: Voice priority: last / top / bottom; voice stealing

items.name: Legato Glide Default
items.essentials: Glide on, legato mode: tied notes glide, separate notes jump.
concepts: Glide / portamento time; legato mode as default

items.name: Portamento Control (Phantom Note)
items.essentials: CC84 sets a phantom pitch; the next note glides from it with nothing before.
concepts: CC5 / CC65 / CC68 / CC84 portamento control (phantom note)

items.name: Additive Organ Drawbars
items.essentials: Sines at harmonics 1–9 with the drawbar-style levels; switch envelope.
concepts: Additive: sines in a harmonic series

items.name: FM vs Additive: Two Sines
items.essentials: Two sines: first summed (two partials), then one modulating the other (many partials).

families.name: LFO Behaviours
families.note: The LFO's modes, each on a vibrato or a filter sweep so the difference is audible.

items.name: Natural Vibrato
items.essentials: Dedicated vibrato LFO, sine/triangle, 5 Hz, depth under a semitone, to pitch.
concepts: Vibrato: ~5 Hz, under a semitone; dedicated vibrato LFO

items.name: Vibrato Fade-In (LFO Attack)
items.essentials: Vibrato depth ramps in over 300–800 ms after note-on.

items.name: Mod Wheel → Vibrato Depth
items.essentials: Pitch LFO depth set high, CC1 scales it from zero.

items.name: Tempo-Synced Filter LFO
items.essentials: LFO on cutoff at 1/8, then 1/8 triplet.

items.name: Retrigger vs Free LFO (Chords)
items.essentials: Slow filter LFO; play staggered chords with retrigger off (one LFO for all) then on (one per voice).
concepts: Retrigger vs free; chords with staggered attacks

items.name: Keytracked LFO Rate
items.essentials: Vibrato with key → rate so no two voices sync.
items.teaches: Key → LFO rate for ensemble realism

items.name: Velocity → LFO Rate
items.essentials: Vibrato with velocity → rate.

items.name: Fast LFO into Audio Range
items.essentials: LFO on pitch swept from 5 Hz up past 20 Hz into tone.
concepts: LFO rate range vs oscillator; LFO into audio rate

items.name: LFO → Pan
items.essentials: Pad with slow LFO on pan; then per-voice random pan.

items.name: Aftertouch → Filter
items.essentials: Pressure opens the filter on held notes.

items.name: Pitch Bend Range
items.essentials: Bend range at whole step, minor third, octave.

families.name: Delay-Family Effects
families.note: Delays inside the synth: time, feedback, mix, and the LFO that brings them alive.

items.name: Simple Delay
items.essentials: Pluck into a synced stereo delay: time, feedback, mix.

items.name: Feedback to the Edge
items.essentials: Delay feedback 0% → 100% → beyond, carefully.

items.name: Short Delay = Comb Filter
items.essentials: Noise or saw mixed with a 1 ms copy; sweep the time and hear the harmonic series move.
items.teaches: Delay time and frequency are reciprocals
concepts: Comb filter: a short delay is a filter
Comb filter: delay time and frequency are reciprocals

items.name: Flanger
items.essentials: Short delay with feedback and an LFO on delay time; on noise, hats, bright synth.
concepts: Flanger: comb in motion with feedback

items.name: Phaser
items.essentials: All-pass stages with LFO; notches not in a harmonic series.
concepts: Phaser: notches not in a harmonic series

items.name: Chorus
items.essentials: Several delay lines, each with its own LFO, no feedback, stereo.
concepts: Chorus: multiple delays, own LFOs, no feedback

items.name: Envelope-Follower Delay
items.essentials: Phaser or flanger delay time driven by an envelope follower on the input.

items.name: Stereo Width by L/R Delay
items.essentials: Same sound, left delayed 0–30 ms vs right; then modulate.
concepts: Stereo width by L/R delay difference; detune and filter per side

items.name: Stereo Width by Detune and Filter
items.essentials: Left and right oscillators detuned, left and right filters set differently.
concepts: Stereo width by L/R delay difference; detune and filter per side

items.name: Comb Filter for Thinning
items.essentials: Static comb on a big distorted sound to fit it in a mix without dulling it.
concepts: Comb filter: a short delay is a filter
Comb filtering for thinning a rich source

items.name: Reverb as Long Release
items.essentials: Same pad with release 0 + reverb, vs long release + no reverb.

families.name: Performance Controls
families.note: Standard CCs and keyboard modulations, each as a saved template routing.

items.name: Velocity → Amplitude and Filter
items.essentials: Velocity to amp and to filter cutoff: accents are louder and brighter.

items.name: Velocity → Filter Envelope Amount
items.essentials: Velocity scales the filter envelope depth: brighter attack, same sustain.
concepts: Velocity → filter envelope amount; → pitch envelope amount

items.name: Velocity → Pitch Envelope Amount
items.essentials: Accented notes get a bigger pitch blip.
concepts: Velocity → filter envelope amount; → pitch envelope amount

items.name: Key → Filter Cutoff (Keytracking)
items.essentials: Cutoff follows key at 0%, 50%, 100%.

items.name: Key → Pan
items.essentials: Low notes left, high notes right.

items.name: CC74 Brightness
items.essentials: CC74 to cutoff.

items.name: CC73 / CC72 Attack and Release
items.essentials: CC73 to amp attack, CC72 to amp release: legato vs staccato on one sound.
concepts: CC7 volume, CC11 expression, CC72 release, CC73 attack
CC73 / CC72 → attack / release; CC → decay

items.name: CC → Decay on Percussive
items.essentials: A CC controls decay time on a no-sustain sound: the length knob.
concepts: CC73 / CC72 → attack / release; CC → decay

items.name: Volume vs Expression (CC7 / CC11)
items.essentials: CC7 for the mix level, CC11 for phrase dynamics as a percentage of it.
concepts: CC7 volume, CC11 expression, CC72 release, CC73 attack

items.name: Modulation Template (Init Patch)
items.essentials: Saw, LP, standard primary and secondary routings all wired at sensible defaults; saved as the starting point.
items.teaches: The init patch as a template for every patch
concepts: Modulation template saved as the init patch
